mapper.select:
SELECT M.USER_ID AS userId, M.GRP_ID AS grpId, U.NAME AS userName, U.TEL AS tel, U.EMAIL AS email, G.NAME AS grpName, TO_CHAR(M.PRJ_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS prjStartDate FROM USERS U JOIN MEMBER M ON U.ID = M.USER_ID JOIN GRP G ON M.GRP_ID = G.ID
ORDER BY M.USER_ID

SELECT M.ID AS memberId, M.USER_ID AS userId, M.GRP_ID AS grpId, G.PRJ_ID AS prjId, U.NAME AS userName, TO_CHAR(U.HIRE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS hireDate, U.GENDER_CD AS genderCd, U.EMAIL AS email, U.TEL AS tel, U.LOGIN AS login, NULL AS lastLoginOn, U.PW_UPDATED_ON AS pwUpdatedOn, P.PRJ_NAME AS prjName, TO_CHAR(M.PRJ_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS prjStartDate, TO_CHAR(M.PRJ_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS prjEndDate, G.NAME AS grpName FROM MEMBER M JOIN USERS U ON U.ID = M.USER_ID JOIN GRP G ON G.ID = M.GRP_ID LEFT JOIN project P ON P.ID = G.PRJ_ID WHERE G.PRJ_ID = #{prjId} AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.GRP_ID = #{grpId} AND M.PRJ_END_DATE IS NULL AND G.STATUS_CD = '01ACTIVE'

SELECT get_sub_code_name(I.PRIORITY_CD) AS priorityCd, I.SUBJECT AS subject, get_sub_code_name(I.CATEGORY_CD) AS categoryCd, get_sub_code_name(I.STATUS_CD) AS statusCd, NULL AS requesterName, GET_USERID_TO_NAME(I.MEM_ID) AS assigneeName, I.EST_START_DATE AS estStartDate, I.DUE_DATE AS dueDate, I.START_DATE AS startDate, I.CLOSED_DATE AS closedDate, I.DONE_RATIO AS doneRatio FROM ISSUE I WHERE I.PRJ_ID = #{prjId} AND I.MEM_ID = ( SELECT M.ID FROM MEMBER M JOIN GRP G ON G.ID = M.GRP_ID WHERE G.PRJ_ID = #{prjId} AND M.USER_ID = #{userId} AND M.GRP_ID = #{grpId} AND M.PRJ_END_DATE IS NULL AND G.STATUS_CD = '01ACTIVE' ) ORDER BY I.PRIORITY_CD DESC, I.ID
